points.quote: This means that getting a correct answer through AI is not enough to get a good grade.
points.gist: Getting a correct answer through AI is not enough to get a good grade.

points.quote: we’ve reviewed and updated assessments so they measure your thought processes and understanding, as well as the final answer.
points.gist: Assessments have been reviewed and updated to measure thought processes and understanding as well as the final answer.

points.quote: We want all students at Surrey to have equal access to AI so you can all engage with tools to support your learning and get prepared for the working world.
points.gist: Surrey wants all students to have equal access to AI tools.

points.quote: That’s why we’ve integrated AI into every module in ways that make sense for your subject.
points.gist: AI has been integrated into every module in ways that suit the subject.

points.quote: You’ll be learning to judge AI critically to support, not replace your learning.
points.gist: Students learn to judge AI critically so it supports, not replaces, their learning.

points.quote: Surrey’s AI in Education Framework is a progressive approach to AI developed with the Students’ Union.
points.gist: The AI in Education Framework was developed with the Students' Union.
